excerpt.quote: **Scientific adequacy: supported for the reported, bounded conclusion.** The report's conclusion is that the supplied maps do not provide whole-brain-corrected support for a positive vmPFC gain effect; it explicitly does not claim that the underlying effect is exactly zero. The group analysis includes all 54 equal-indifference participants and tests their participant-level gain COPEs with a positive-direction one-sample t statistic. Participant-wise sign flips and the maximum t statistic across the common nonzero mask provide whole-brain family-wise error control at .05 (`analysis/analyze.py`, `results/summary.json`). The method and its symmetric-null assumption are stated (`report.md`).
